Fix sketch: T (L_ID_DUST_AQUAMARINE: 3% -> 5%) Triage 2026-10-26: Dust item text says 3%; code and the property text say 5%. text_fix.en_proposed: This item can be taken to the Enchanter to add the following property to your Spell Gems:\n\nCascading: the spell's potency is increased by 5% for each Charge the Spell Gem is missing.
